import json,sys,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import pymupdf
from aspose.words_foss import light_document_model as ldm
import aspose.words_foss as aw
from aspose.words_foss.pdf_writer import LdmPdfWriter
from aspose.words_foss.saving import PdfSaveOptions
assert 'site-packages' in aw.__file__, aw.__file__
records={}
for align in (0,1,2):
 for location in ('body','table'):
  for shaped in (False,True):
   runs=[ldm.Run(text=f'[{t}](https://example.test/{t})',font=ldm.Font(size=s,underline=True,strike_through=True,highlight_color='FFFF00')) for t,s in zip('QZK',(12,18,14))]
   p=ldm.Paragraph(children=runs,paragraph_format=ldm.ParagraphFormat(alignment=align))
   item=p if location=='body' else ldm.Table(rows=[ldm.Row(cells=[ldm.Cell(children=[p])])])
   model=ldm.Document(sections=[ldm.Section(page_setup=ldm.PageSetup(page_width=240,page_height=150,left_margin=15,right_margin=15,top_margin=15,bottom_margin=15),body=ldm.Body(children=[item]))])
   options=PdfSaveOptions();options.text_shaping=shaped
   raw=LdmPdfWriter(options).write_to_bytes(model)
   key=f'{align}-{location}-{shaped}'
   with pymupdf.open(stream=raw,filetype='pdf') as pdf:
    page=pdf[0]
    chars=[{'text':c['c'],'size':span['size'],'origin':c['origin']} for b in page.get_text('rawdict')['blocks'] for line in b.get('lines',[]) for span in line['spans'] for c in span['chars']]
    records[key]={'bytes':len(raw),'pages':len(pdf),'chars':chars,'drawings':[list(d['rect']) for d in page.get_drawings()],'links':[{'uri':l['uri'],'rect':list(l['from'])} for l in page.get_links()],'pixels':hashlib.sha256(page.get_pixmap().samples).hexdigest()}
    if key=='0-body-False':page.get_pixmap(matrix=pymupdf.Matrix(3,3)).save(f'/tmp/docweave-decoration-{sys.argv[1]}.png')
Path(f'/tmp/docweave-decoration-{sys.argv[1]}.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
print(len(records),'cases',sum(r['pages'] for r in records.values()),'pages')

import ast,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import aspose.words_foss as aw
assert ('docweave-prior-site-packages' in aw.__file__) == (sys.argv[1] == 'before'), aw.__file__
p=Path('/Users/sheny/Developer/code/Aspose.Words-FOSS-for-Python/tests/test_pdf_mixed_baselines.py')
tree=ast.parse(p.read_text())
keep=[]
for node in tree.body:
 if isinstance(node,(ast.Import,ast.ImportFrom)) and not (isinstance(node,ast.ImportFrom) and node.module.endswith('.baseline')):
  keep.append(node)
 elif isinstance(node,ast.FunctionDef) and node.name in ('baseline_model','glyphs','test_wrapped_plain_strike_draws_every_line_without_spanning_pages'):
  keep.append(node)
ns={};exec(compile(ast.Module(body=keep,type_ignores=[]),str(p),'exec'),ns)
results=[]
for highlight in (False,True):
 try:
  ns['test_wrapped_plain_strike_draws_every_line_without_spanning_pages'](highlight)
  status='pass'
 except AssertionError:
  status='assertion_failure'
 assert (status=='assertion_failure') == (sys.argv[1]=='before'), (highlight,status)
 results.append({'highlight':highlight,'status':status})
Path('/tmp/docweave-strike-regression-'+sys.argv[1]+'.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
print(aw.__file__,results)
